destructive_warning: Writing this candidate will erase the existing DOS partition table and all data on /dev/sdb1, including the EDGEAI_DATA volume.

expected_layout.source: make_parted.sh static branch with boards/DR1M/configs/.cfg MLK_BOOTSCR_NAME=parameter-tf-fat.txt
expected_layout.not_created: No ext4 partition is created by this parameter-tf-fat branch. deploy_image.sh partition-2 logic is therefore not applicable unless a different approved boot configuration is selected.

candidate_file_destinations.rootfs_tar_gz: Not copied by deploy_image.sh for the one-partition parameter-tf-fat branch; retained as candidate/rootfs provenance and alternate ext4 deployment input.
candidate_file_destinations.kernel_modules: Embedded in the candidate rootfs/uInitrd; not copied as separate files by deploy_image.sh.
candidate_file_destinations.source_mapping: The reviewed parameter-tf-fat boot script loads uInitrd.lz4 from the FAT root. The candidate staging tree stores the same frozen uInitrd under rootfs/, so the controlled deployment wrapper maps rootfs/uInitrd.lz4 to the FAT-root destination uInitrd.lz4 without changing bytes.

candidate_assembly_normalization.reason: candidate staging path differs from the parameter-tf-fat boot-root contract

write_sequence_after_separate_approval: Re-enumerate /dev/sdb and match path, stable_id, size_bytes, model, serial, transport, removable=1 and read_only=0.
Obtain a second explicit confirmation that all EDGEAI_DATA contents will be destroyed.
Only then run the reviewed make_parted.sh path to create the msdos/FAT32 BOOT partition.
Re-read the partition table and verify exactly one bootable FAT32 partition.
Run the controlled reviewed deployment wrapper to copy the boot directory, map rootfs/uInitrd.lz4 to boot-root/uInitrd.lz4, and sync.
Re-read the mounted partition and compare every boot file SHA256 to the frozen candidate manifest.
Keep the candidate source SHA256SUMS and write log; do not proceed to board boot if any check differs.
post_write_verification: verify msdos table, one FAT32 BOOT partition and boot flag
read back each boot destination and compare SHA256
verify candidate source SHA256SUMS remains unchanged
verify no unexpected partition or filesystem
stop_conditions: serial or stable identity becomes unavailable
candidate hash mismatch or missing source file
existing partition remains mounted when a write phase begins
script requests an unreviewed command or unexpected partition
device disconnect, I/O error or any unexpected filesystem
recovery: stop immediately and do not retry on another device
do not remove the SD until I/O is quiescent
restore the original eMMC boot selection only after separate physical approval
use serial recovery and a known-good eMMC path if SD boot fails
serial_first_boot: select SD boot without modifying eMMC
verify kernel, DTB, FPGA, CMA and partition identities
verify driver probe and expected device nodes
stop on any mismatch before loading or running NPU software
